handoff: Skill edit does what the issue asks, but no test pins any Wanted item (no frontmatter criteria → verifier test → all UNTRACED, blocking by the new rule): add a content test for norn-review in assets.test.ts. Minor: drop QV1/QV2 ids from the shipped craft skill (P7).

findings.title: No test proves any Wanted item (all rows UNTRACED)
findings.detail:
Spec Wanted: 'The Spec axis builds a table: one row per Behaviour item / acceptance criterion, with the test file and test name that proves it, or UNTRACED.' / 'An UNTRACED item is a blocking finding, unless the criterion's verifier is agent or person (QV1).' / 'The table goes into the review's handoff'. The spec has no frontmatter criteria, so each item counts as verifier: test (the new step 4). grep finds no test mentioning UNTRACED or asserting norn-review content; the skill tests in assets.test.ts check only the frontmatter, links, glossary words and P7 wording. A later edit could drop the table, the exemption or the handoff step with every test green. There is precedent for content tests: 'the norn skill states the protocol and hard rules' asserts key strings in the norn skill.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a unit test in packages/cli/test/unit/assets.test.ts asserting that the norn-review skill contains the traceability table (e.g. 'UNTRACED', '| Item | Verifier | Proven by |'), the agent/person exemption ('QA (agent)', 'QA (person)') and the handoff step. Optionally, assert that .agents/skills/norn-review/SKILL.md equals the bundled copy.

findings.title: Shipped craft skill cites norn rule ids QV1/QV2
findings.detail:
P7: 'The briefing carries the process, skills carry the craft.' The sibling craft skills norn-qa and norn-slice describe verifiers and the criteria report without citing rule ids. The new step 4 says '(QV1)' and '(QV2)'. Those ids mean nothing in a repo that installed norn, since RULES.md is this repo's own file. The P7 test bans only the word 'norn', so it passes.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop '(QV1)' and '(QV2)' from the skill text; keep them in the RULES.md skills row.
